report: Reviewed the complete direct_members claim and all five ordinary implementation associations. local_syms/mods.rs iterates the unexpanded vector and appends source symbols directly; a child Mod and a Use remain individual entries and neither child's items nor imported target names are spliced into the parent. parse/mod.rs visits syntax children in order and parse/items.rs returns one module symbol, specifying inline children under ScopeSymbol::Module(child); file-backed children likewise retain their own body source. parse_use records syntax imports rather than resolving them. This establishes the direct-member versus visible-name boundary: namespace lookup is not performed to populate this result (macro lookup is used only to select expansion definitions). Ordering is deterministic: source iteration is sequential, bang output recursively appends at the invocation position, and derives append after the source item in attribute/list order. Source provenance is retained by passing unchanged symbols; parsing constructs item spans from the supplied ParseSource, with absolute_span preserving that source. local_syms/macro_invocations.rs parse_output uses BangMacro(definition, invocation) and the invocation scope. derive.rs parse_output uses Derive(expansion) and the source struct/enum scope; DeriveExpansion retains source item and occurrence identifiers. Thus generated items keep distinct expansion provenance while remaining siblings of their invocation/source item. Empty output and omitted errors/unsupported expansion do not introduce imported or nested items; expansion completeness is separately specified. The parser and both generated-output helpers now have explicit anchor associations so changes to these essential files invalidate this assessment. The only associated test is todo::modules_expand_direct_members in semantic_spec.rs. Its body has no assertions and supplies no executed behavioral coverage. Its explicit TODO accurately identifies the remaining prerequisite: construct the ordinary/use/inline-child/recursive-output/derive fixture matrix and assert membership, ordering, ownership, and provenance, including exclusion of child and imported names. This existing deferral is accepted as TODO, not reclassified as verified behavior. In particular a flattening, reorder, or lost provenance regression is not claimed to be caught by this placeholder. No implementation violation was identified by source inspection. Commands executed: cargo fmt passed; cargo build passed with existing warnings; cargo test -p sage-meta --test semantic_spec modules_expand_direct_members passed its one empty TODO test, which does not validate semantics. Review start/read captured the final associations, implementation files, supporting span helper, module design context and review decision rule. Centralized delegated post-codegen and Sage sanity checks remain the coordinator's responsibility for the association-only edits.
